policy: Reference archives provide research evidence only. No protected images, essays, or signature assets are vendored.

entries.name: AIGA Medal and Design History resources
entries.absorb: Designer names, historical context, credited career essays and teaching references.
entries.restrictions: Do not copy essays or images; write independent method summaries with attribution links.

entries.name: Alliance Graphique Internationale members and work archive
entries.absorb: Global graphic-design practitioner index, countries, disciplines and credited works.
entries.restrictions: No bulk image ingestion or profile copying. Names are discovery seeds, not authority by themselves.

entries.name: The One Club Creative / ADC Hall of Fame
entries.absorb: Cross-disciplinary art direction, advertising, editorial, photography and design lineage discovery.
entries.restrictions: No copied biographies or portfolio images.

entries.name: Type Directors Club Medalists and typography archive
entries.absorb: Typography masters, award history, type and communication-design study seeds.
entries.restrictions: Do not redistribute annuals, images, or medalist essays.

entries.name: MoMA Architecture and Design collection
entries.license: Reference-only; object and image rights vary
entries.absorb: Object metadata, credited designers, movement relationships, media and exhibition context.
entries.restrictions: Respect per-object licensing; no collection-image vendoring.

entries.name: Cooper Hewitt National Design Awards archive
entries.absorb: Cross-disciplinary award roster, impact categories, contemporary design leaders and juror context.
entries.restrictions: Do not copy award imagery or biographies.

entries.name: Letterform Archive
entries.absorb: Lettering, typography, calligraphy and graphic-design historical research pathways.
entries.restrictions: No bulk photography download; use collection metadata for study planning.

entries.name: Vignelli Center for Design Studies archives
entries.absorb: Process evidence across identity, editorial, product, interiors, exhibitions, wayfinding and packaging.
entries.restrictions: Do not redistribute archive assets; translate observations into independent design principles.

entries.name: Bauhaus-Archiv / Museum für Gestaltung collection
entries.absorb: Bauhaus teaching, preliminary courses, typography, objects, textiles and architecture lineages.
entries.restrictions: No image reproduction without item permission.

entries.name: HfG-Archiv Ulm
entries.absorb: Systems design, visual communication, product rationalism, Otl Aicher process and Ulm methodology.
entries.restrictions: No archive-image copying; cite project records.

entries.name: Japan Graphic Designers Association awards and archive
entries.absorb: Japanese poster, identity, editorial, packaging, spatial, digital and integrated-design references.
entries.restrictions: No copying award images or annual pages.

entries.name: Ginza Graphic Gallery / DNP Foundation
entries.license: Reference-only; site and exhibition rights apply
entries.absorb: Japanese and international exhibition history, lectures and graphic-design publication research seeds.
entries.restrictions: No copying exhibition assets or books.

entries.name: Pritzker Architecture Prize laureates archive
entries.license: Reference-only; site copyright and photography rights apply
entries.absorb: Architecture masters, jury citations, selected works and social/contextual design criteria.
entries.restrictions: No copying photographs or full jury texts.

entries.name: ADI Design Museum Compasso d’Oro historical collection
entries.license: Reference-only; collection and publication rights apply
entries.absorb: Italian industrial design history, products, craft, manufacturing and design culture.
entries.restrictions: Do not reproduce catalog essays or images.

entries.name: Design Museum designer profiles
entries.absorb: Cross-disciplinary designer profiles and documented design principles.
entries.restrictions: Independent summaries only; do not copy profile text.

entries.name: Art of the Title
entries.license: Reference-only; footage and article rights apply
entries.absorb: Credited title-sequence creators, interviews, process and motion-typography lineages.
entries.restrictions: No video or frame redistribution.

entries.name: TASTE designer-annotated multidimensional graphic-design preference study
entries.license: Paper reference; dataset terms must be reviewed separately
entries.absorb: Multidimensional designer evaluation, pairwise preference, hallucination flags and judge-agreement caution.
entries.restrictions: Do not import dataset until its license is verified; methods may be independently implemented.

entries.name: Brief2Design
entries.license: Paper reference; code/data terms require review
entries.absorb: Brief structuring, element-level exploration and recombination before final composition.
entries.restrictions: Independent implementation only until code/data license is verified.

entries.name: Demystifying Tacit Knowledge in Graphic Design
entries.absorb: Capture designer actions, purposes, decision cues, exceptions and contextual reasoning rather than style labels alone.
entries.restrictions: Do not copy paper text; implement an original method-card schema.

entries.name: PerceptualSimilarity / LPIPS
entries.absorb: Optional perceptual regression comparison between iterations and reference-safe layout checks.
entries.restrictions: Never use as a master-style copying target; retain notices.

entries.name: DISTS perceptual image similarity
entries.absorb: Optional structure/texture-aware visual regression between project iterations.
entries.restrictions: Not an aesthetic judge and not a replacement for professional critique.

entries.name: IQA-PyTorch
entries.absorb: Research reference for image-quality metrics coverage.
entries.restrictions: Do not integrate into commercial runtime without separate commercial permission.
